name: effect-subframe-motion-blur
title: Subframe Motion Blur
description: Mỗi khung hình là trung bình của nhiều lần chụp lệch nhau trong một khung, nên vật chạy nhanh có vệt nhoè tự nhiên.py mp4 --blur`.

moworks.author: moworks

options.gap: s between them (0.012: a 270° shutter over 8 subframes at 24 fps is about this)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Each output frame averages 8 renders between t - 0.75 frame and t (270 deg shutter; 4-8 subframes, or 1 sample per 5 px moved, max 64). Demo: a box moving 240 px each way in 0.8 s (ease-in-out ping-pong); top row without blur, bottom row = 8 copies 12 ms apart at 20 % each. Params: subframes (8) · shutter (270°). A real render averages 4–8 subframes between t − 0.75 frame and t; here copies at earlier times stand in for them.
